study.question: Does a fixed nonlinear auxiliary readout shape, with a free prevalence bias, make the expected shuffled-label training signal useful to the history encoder, or does the prior small improvement depend on head adaptation? Observed starting point: static/pooled/DIN AUCs 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861 establish a useful history reference. Aligned history auxiliary supervision worsened AUC to 0.6129014321; detached recovered baseline; permuted and target-only controls reached 0.6134907830 and 0.6134556006. Expected-permuted reached 0.6136336662; mean-only 0.6133191315, dispersion-only 0.6135891495 and neither 0.6133619861. These are same-seed trajectories, not independent replication. At the selected checkpoint expected-permuted auxiliary variance was 0.00010053 and dispersion-only 0.000000979 versus neither 0.033156 on only the first 512 validation rows; pooled norms remain nonzero, which does not establish preserved information. Low output variance does not tell whether the learned head flattened or histories changed.
study.hypothesis: The trainable auxiliary head can adapt toward a constant output, weakening its constraint on pooled history. Freezing its two weight matrices and hidden bias while allowing its output bias to calibrate prevalence removes parameter adaptation of the readout shape. At inherited loss weight 0.2 this may provide a useful persistent projected-history constraint with unchanged inference. This is provisional: generic optimization perturbation, head gate saturation and harmful erasure of useful history are competing explanations.

nearest_work.difference: Author README verifies category/brand/type histories and absent item IDs. No item identity or next-event labels are invented. Publisher full paper remains unavailable; detailed difference from DMR training objectives and broader novelty are unverified.

inherited_components: Entire DIN-style reference encoder and primary inference readout, initialization order, causal masks and recency buckets.

Expected-permutation loss identity: q is detached mean of current nonempty training labels; M=softplus(mean z)-q*mean z, D=mean softplus(z)-softplus(mean z); M+D is expected shuffled-label BCE. No aligned auxiliary labels or sampled permutation.
Host data/scoring/resource ownership, optimizer, epochs, sample coverage and fixed seed.
Forked CPU RNG for auxiliary initialization so additions do not advance host RNG.
study.proposed_difference: Fixed random nonlinear head shape plus a trainable scalar output bias is the new candidate training signal. A 2x2 head-shape (fixed/learned) by encoder-gradient (routed/blocked) suite isolates the changed route and its interaction with head adaptation. Every module is standalone. Learned-routed exactly retains the inherited training math; buffers and expanded no_grad diagnostics never enter training. Record initial-shape logit variance on the same final pooled vectors, analytic current/initial head Jacobian norms, hidden active fraction, zero-Jacobian fraction, shape drift, covariance trace/participation, trainable auxiliary count and inherited diagnostics. These measurements are descriptive, not probes of predictive usability. No global novelty claim: authorized searches for regularization/random projection and confidence/label smoothing returned no indexed matches, which does not establish absence of prior work.
predictions: At seed 42 learned_routed should reproduce ancestor AUC 0.6136336662060191 and Logloss 0.19671352909103915; both blocked arms should reproduce baseline-din / g3-r0001-neither AUC 0.6133619861190683 and Logloss 0.19679464647483236 up to host numerical tolerance. Validate this before causal interpretation.

If trainable-head flattening explains low auxiliary variance, learned_routed will have lower trained-head variance/Jacobian norm than its initial head evaluated on the same final pooled vectors; fixed-shape drift must be exactly zero. This is localization evidence on 512 rows, not proof of the performance mechanism.

If a persistent fixed-shape signal is useful, fixed_routed will improve AUC by at least 0.0002 over fixed_blocked with Logloss degradation at most 0.0001, nonzero head sensitivity and no gross covariance collapse. Beating learned_routed by 0.0002 would additionally support preferring fixed shape; smaller differences remain inconclusive pending repeats.

All arms execute identical inference operations; acceptable screening cost is training wall time <=1.2x learned_routed and inference p95 <=1.1x after accounting for timing noise. Total head parameters remain 577; fixed shape has 1 trainable auxiliary parameter versus 577 learned; active inference parameters remain the reference count. No equal-compute claim from equal epochs.

Report host pre-existing history-length, behavior, hour and training-frequency slices with counts as exploratory; do not select new bins after seeing results. Sparse slices and first-512 diagnostics cannot substantiate population-level claims.
falsifiers: Fixed routed-blocked AUC contrast is nonpositive, or any apparent gain has unacceptable Logloss/cost degradation: this candidate has no demonstrated practical benefit.

Learned-routed current-head sensitivity is not reduced relative to its initial-shape diagnostic, or low output variance tracks low initial-head variance and pooled covariance instead: the head-flattening explanation is not localized by these data.
Fixed-routed has near-zero Jacobian or mostly inactive hidden units: fixed weights failed to maintain a sensitive regularizer, so a null outcome cannot refute a persistent non-saturating signal.
Blocked arms fail to recover the reference or learned-routed fails to recover its ancestor: suspend attribution and investigate code/host reproducibility rather than report a mechanism effect.
A seed-42 improvement disappears or reverses in reserved paired repetitions: report unstable or null support; no significance claim from repeated exposures or one seed.
alternative_explanations: Freezing shape intentionally reduces auxiliary trainable parameters from 577 to 1 (576 fewer); this is the factor being tested, not a fully matched trainable-capacity claim.
The same loss weight need not produce equal encoder gradient magnitudes as head shape changes; checkpoint diagnostics do not measure cumulative gradients.
Frozen ReLU shape can still become insensitive by representation motion into inactive regions or its nullspace; sensitivity and covariance diagnostics distinguish only some alternatives.
One seed and first-512-row checkpoint diagnostics are preliminary, not full-population mechanism evidence. User-cluster intervals are unavailable through this proposal interface.
The mean term may shift shared category/brand embeddings used by both static and historical paths; an effect cannot be uniquely assigned to history-only information acquisition.
Representation variance and head Jacobian norms do not identify label-relevant information; a useful perturbation may be transient rather than a persistent constraint.
Historical factorial main effects and interaction are small and selected on validation; checkpoint selection and seed variation may account for them.
The static publisher snapshots lack verified as-of dates; all conclusions stay within the frozen benchmark assumption, not production point-in-time validity.
